subject.title: Write tool lacks append mode — isolated cron sessions destroy shared files

question: Should OpenClaw accept `append?: boolean` on the existing `write` tool as the supported append contract, or require a different append API before closing this issue?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the remaining fix changes a model-facing and extension-observable tool contract rather than a purely internal implementation detail.

options.title: Accept append on write
options.body: Land the open implementation after refresh and review, keeping overwrite as the default and using `append: true` for safe accumulation.

options.title: Choose a different append contract
options.body: Ask for a replacement shape such as `mode: "append"` or a dedicated append tool before merging any public API.

options.title: Defer code and document workarounds
options.body: Keep the issue open and rely on backup or shell-redirect workarounds, accepting that ordinary write-call data-loss risk remains.

recommendation.title: Accept append on write
recommendation.body: Land the open implementation after refresh and review, keeping overwrite as the default and using `append: true` for safe accumulation.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for the shared write-tool contract is the agent runtime internalization work, and this decision is about that model-facing runtime API.
